import json
import subprocess

# Test various control characters
control_chars = {
    "null": "\x00",
    "tab": "\t",
    "newline": "\n",
    "carriage_return": "\r",
    "bell": "\x07",
    "delete": "\x7f"
}

for name, char in control_chars.items():
    test_input = {
        "pipeline": {"steps": [
            {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "col" + char]}
        ]},
        "dataset": []
    }
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
        input=json.dumps(test_input),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    print(f"Control char test - {name}:")
    print(f"  Status: {output['status']}")
    print(f"  Error code: {output.get('error_code')}")
    print()

# Test valid strings with special printable characters
test_input_valid = {
    "pipeline": {"steps": [
        {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "name!@#$%^&*()"]}
    ]},
    "dataset": []
}

result_valid = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
    input=json.dumps(test_input_valid),
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

output_valid = json.loads(result_valid.stdout)
print("Valid printable special chars test:")
print(f"  Status: {output_valid['status']}")

import json
import subprocess

# Test all field types mentioned in the requirement
test_cases = [
    ("op", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "x" * 65, "columns": ["id"]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("select columns", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["x" * 65]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("filter where", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "filter", "where": "x" * 65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("map as", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "x" * 65, "expr": "1"}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("map expr", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "a", "expr": "x" * 65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("rename from", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "from": "x" * 65, "to": "y"}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("rename to", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "from": "x", "to": "y" * 65}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("rename mapping value", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "rename", "mapping": {"x": "y" * 65}}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("branch id", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"id": "x" * 65, "when": "1", "steps": []}]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("branch when", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "x" * 65, "steps": []}]}]}, "dataset": []}),
    ("merge strategy", {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "branch", "branches": [{"when": "1", "steps": []}], "merge": {"strategy": "x" * 65}}]}, "dataset": []}),
]

print("Testing all field types:")
print("-" * 60)
for field_name, test_input in test_cases:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
        input=json.dumps(test_input),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    
    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
    status = output.get('status')
    error_code = output.get('error_code')
    path = output.get('path', 'N/A')
    
    print(f"{field_name:25} | Status: {status:5} | Path: {path}")

print("-" * 60)
EOF
